examples.en: Universities must abide by ethical rules when conducting experiments on human volunteers.
examples.zh: 大学在对人类志愿者进行实验时必须遵守伦理规则。

examples.en: Because of a severe migraine, Professor Lin will be absent from tomorrow’s policy seminar.
examples.zh: 由于严重偏头痛，林教授将缺席明天的政策研讨会。

examples.en: In a moment of absence of mind, the pharmacist put her keys in the medicine cabinet.
examples.zh: 药剂师一时心不在焉，把钥匙放进了药柜。

meaning: 专注做某事；沉浸在……之中；全神贯注于……

examples.en: Absorbed in decoding the ancient manuscript, Mei failed to notice that the library was closing.
examples.zh: 梅沉浸在破解古代手稿中，没有注意到图书馆要关门了。

examples.en: The coastal wetland is abundant in plant species that can tolerate salty water.
examples.zh: 这片滨海湿地富含能够耐受盐水的植物物种。

meaning: 不可数名词) 能接近,进入,了解

examples.en: Affordable broadband gives remote villages access to online courses and medical consultations.
examples.zh: 负担得起的宽带使偏远村庄能够使用在线课程和医疗咨询服务。

meaning: 偶然地,意外. Without accident(=safely) 安全地,

examples.en: A laboratory assistant discovered the contamination by accident while cleaning the microscope.
examples.zh: 一名实验室助理在清洁显微镜时意外发现了污染。

examples.en: Without being asked, several employees stayed of their own accord to restore the damaged database.
examples.zh: 几名员工未经要求便自愿留下来恢复受损的数据库。

meaning: 与...一致 . out of one's accord with 同....不一致

examples.en: The new recycling rules are in accord with the city’s long-term environmental goals.
examples.zh: 新的回收规定与该市的长期环境目标一致。

examples.en: With one accord, the villagers rejected the plan to build on protected farmland.
examples.zh: 村民们一致反对在受保护农田上进行建设的计划。

examples.en: Patient records must be stored in accordance with national privacy regulations.
examples.zh: 患者记录必须依照国家隐私法规保存。

meaning: 为了某人的缘故, 为了某人自己的利益 2) (=at one's own risk) 自行负责 3) (=by oneself)依靠自己 on account 赊账; on account of 因为; on no account 不论什么原因也不;of ...account 有.....重 要性.

examples.en: After leaving the firm, Jia began advising small businesses on her own account.
examples.zh: 离开公司后，佳开始独立为小企业提供咨询。

examples.en: Any estimate of future water demand should take population growth into account.
examples.zh: 对未来用水需求的任何估算都应把人口增长考虑在内。

examples.en: Could you give the review panel an account of how the equipment failed?
examples.zh: 你能向审查小组说明设备是如何发生故障的吗？

examples.en: Renewable energy now accounts for nearly a third of the province’s electricity supply.
examples.zh: 可再生能源目前占该省电力供应的近三分之一。

examples.en: Several outdoor lectures were cancelled on account of dangerous air pollution.
examples.zh: 由于空气污染严重，几场户外讲座被取消了。

meaning: 绝不要,无论如何不要(放句首时句子要倒装)

examples.en: On no account should researchers alter data to support their original hypothesis.
examples.zh: 研究人员绝不应为了支持原有假设而篡改数据。

examples.en: Local residents accused the factory of releasing untreated waste into the river.
examples.zh: 当地居民指控这家工厂向河中排放未经处理的废水。

examples.en: Having worked remotely for years, Daniel is accustomed to managing projects across time zones.
examples.zh: 丹尼尔远程工作多年，已经习惯了跨时区管理项目。

meaning: 了解; (=to have met socially) 熟悉

examples.en: Although new to the region, the journalist soon became acquainted with its cultural traditions.
examples.zh: 尽管初到该地区，这名记者很快就熟悉了当地的文化传统。

meaning: 奉行,按照...行动; act as 扮演; act for 代理

examples.en: The health department acted on evidence linking the product to serious allergies.
examples.zh: 卫生部门根据将该产品与严重过敏反应联系起来的证据采取了行动。

examples.en: International students often need time to adapt themselves to unfamiliar classroom conventions.
examples.zh: 国际学生往往需要时间使自己适应陌生的课堂惯例。

meaning: 改编, 改写(以适应新的需要)

examples.en: Engineers adapted the navigation software for use by people with visual impairments.
examples.zh: 工程师改造了导航软件，使其适合视障人士使用。

examples.en: The internship offers practical experience; in addition, participants receive career guidance.
examples.zh: 这项实习提供实践经验；此外，参与者还能获得职业指导。

examples.en: In addition to reducing emissions, the railway will create jobs in smaller cities.
examples.zh: 除了减少排放外，这条铁路还将在较小城市创造就业机会。

meaning: 粘附; 坚持, 遵循

examples.en: Even under commercial pressure, the publisher adhered to its fact-checking standards.
examples.zh: 即使面临商业压力，这家出版社仍坚持其事实核查标准。

examples.en: A community clinic stands adjacent to the newly opened nursing college.
examples.zh: 一家社区诊所坐落在新开办的护理学院旁边。

examples.en: Sensors automatically adjust indoor lighting to the amount of daylight available.
examples.zh: 传感器会根据可利用的日光量自动调节室内照明。

examples.en: Given the precise satellite measurements, the claim admits of little doubt.
examples.zh: 鉴于精确的卫星测量结果，这一说法几乎不容怀疑。

examples.en: Applicants will be informed of the interview format one week in advance.
examples.zh: 申请人将提前一周获知面试形式。

meaning: 有利的,使优点更加突出地.

examples.en: Natural light displays the museum’s delicate silk paintings to advantage.
examples.zh: 自然光把博物馆里精美丝绸画的优点充分展现了出来。

meaning: 胜过. have the advantage of 由于...处于有利条件 have the advantage of sb.知道某人所不知道的事

examples.en: Public libraries have an advantage over commercial platforms because their services are free.
examples.zh: 公共图书馆比商业平台更有优势，因为其服务是免费的。

examples.en: Some advertisers take advantage of consumers who do not understand complex loan terms.
examples.zh: 一些广告商利用不了解复杂贷款条款的消费者。

meaning: 赞同(某人意见) agree to 同意

examples.en: I agree with the economist that childcare support can raise workforce participation.
examples.zh: 我赞同这位经济学家的观点，即托育支持可以提高劳动参与率。

examples.en: Our survey findings are broadly in agreement with earlier research on sleep quality.
examples.zh: 我们的调查结果与早期关于睡眠质量的研究大体一致。

meaning: 在...之前, 超过...;.......... ahead of time 提前.

examples.en: By investing in battery technology, the company stayed ahead of its overseas competitors.
examples.zh: 通过投资电池技术，这家公司保持了对海外竞争对手的领先。

meaning: 不肯定, 不具体. 2)在谣传中.

examples.en: A sense of change was in the air as the first electric buses entered service.
examples.zh: 随着首批电动公交车投入运营，变革的气息弥漫开来。

examples.en: Above all, effective public policy must protect those with the fewest resources.
examples.zh: 最重要的是，有效的公共政策必须保护资源最少的人。

examples.en: In all, 480 households participated in the year-long energy-saving trial.
examples.zh: 总共有四百八十户家庭参加了为期一年的节能试验。

meaning: 毕竟,到底; (not) at all 一点也不; all at once(=suddenly)突然; once and for all 只此一次; above all 最重要的; first of all 首先; all in all 大体上说; be all in 累极了; all but 几乎.

examples.en: The old theatre deserves restoration; after all, it has served the community for a century.
examples.zh: 这座老剧院值得修复；毕竟，它已经为社区服务了一个世纪。

examples.en: Travel-time estimates must allow for delays caused by extreme weather.
examples.zh: 出行时间的估算必须考虑极端天气造成的延误。

examples.en: Ignoring safety warnings amounts to placing every laboratory worker at risk.
examples.zh: 无视安全警告就等于把每一位实验室工作人员置于危险之中。

phrase: answer for (undertake responsibility for, be liable for, take charge for)

examples.en: Senior executives should answer for a corporate culture that tolerates discrimination.
examples.zh: 高级管理人员应对容忍歧视的企业文化负责。

examples.en: The device answers to the needs of elderly users with limited mobility.
examples.zh: 这款设备符合行动不便的老年用户的需求。

meaning: 为...焦急不安; 或 anxious for

examples.en: Parents are understandably anxious about the effect of social media on teenagers.
examples.zh: 家长担心社交媒体对青少年的影响，这是可以理解的。

examples.en: The editor apologized to the author for publishing an inaccurate quotation.
examples.zh: 编辑因刊登了不准确的引语而向作者道歉。

meaning: 为某事向某人呼吁. appeal to sb. 对某人有吸引力

examples.en: Facing a funding gap, the food bank appealed to local companies for support.
examples.zh: 面对资金缺口，这家食物银行向当地企业呼吁提供支持。

meaning: 为...向...申请 ; apply for 申请; apply to 适用.

examples.en: Nadia applied to the research council for a grant to study urban heat.
examples.zh: 纳迪娅向研究理事会申请了一笔研究城市热岛的资助。

examples.en: The revised tax rule applies to income earned through digital platforms.
examples.zh: 修订后的税收规定适用于通过数字平台获得的收入。

meaning: 赞成, approve vt. 批准

examples.en: Not every teacher approves of replacing printed textbooks with tablets.
examples.zh: 并非每位教师都赞成用平板电脑取代纸质教材。

examples.en: Many workplace conflicts arise from unclear responsibilities rather than personal hostility.
examples.zh: 许多职场冲突源于职责不清，而非个人敌意。

phrase: arrange for sb./sth. to do sth

examples.en: The university arranged for an interpreter to assist the visiting scholar.
examples.zh: 大学安排了一名口译员协助来访学者。

meaning: 到达; arrive at 到达某地(小地方);得出,作出; arrive in 到达某地(大地方);

examples.en: The medical supplies arrived on the island just before the storm closed the port.
examples.zh: 医疗物资在风暴导致港口关闭前刚好抵达岛上。

examples.en: He felt ashamed of having dismissed a colleague’s idea without hearing the evidence.
examples.zh: 他因未听取证据就否定同事的想法而感到羞愧。

examples.en: The cybersecurity officer assured staff of the backup system’s reliability.
examples.zh: 网络安全主管向员工保证备份系统是可靠的。

examples.en: Attaching economic value to clean air remains both useful and controversial.
examples.zh: 赋予清洁空气经济价值既有用，也仍存在争议。

phrase: make an attempt at doing sth. (to do sth.)

examples.en: After two failed trials, the team made another attempt to stabilize the vaccine.
examples.zh: 在两次试验失败后，团队再次尝试提高疫苗的稳定性。

meaning: 注意,照顾;attend on(upon)(=wait upon, serve, look after) 侍候,照料

examples.en: While the surgeon attended to an emergency, a nurse updated the patient’s family.
examples.zh: 外科医生处理急诊时，一名护士向患者家属通报了情况。

examples.en: Young adults’ attitude toward home ownership has shifted as prices have risen.
examples.zh: 随着房价上涨，年轻人对购房的态度已经发生变化。

meaning: 把..归因于.., 认为..是..的结果

examples.en: Analysts attribute the rise in food prices partly to prolonged drought.
examples.zh: 分析人士把食品价格上涨部分归因于长期干旱。

examples.en: On the average, commuters saved twelve minutes after the new metro line opened.
examples.zh: 新地铁线路开通后，通勤者平均节省了十二分钟。

examples.en: Few consumers are aware of how much personal information a fitness app collects.
examples.zh: 很少有消费者意识到健身应用收集了多少个人信息。

examples.en: At the back of the exhibition hall, visitors can watch craftspeople repair old ceramics.
examples.zh: 在展厅后面，参观者可以观看工匠修复古陶瓷。

meaning: 在...后部(里面); on the back of 在...后部(外面); be on one's back(=be ill in bed) 卧病不起.

examples.en: Emergency blankets and bottled water are stored in the back of the rescue vehicle.
examples.zh: 急救毯和瓶装水存放在救援车的后部。

meaning: 支持,维护; have sb. at one's back 有...支持, 有...作后台

examples.en: With the nurses’ union at his back, the doctor called for safer staffing levels.
examples.zh: 有护士工会支持，这位医生呼吁采用更安全的人员配置标准。

examples.en: A responsible employer cannot turn its back on workers injured on the job.
examples.zh: 负责任的雇主不能抛弃因工受伤的员工。

examples.en: It was unfair to question her professional ability behind her back.
examples.zh: 背着她质疑其专业能力是不公平的。

examples.en: The climate model is based on observations collected over four decades.
examples.zh: 该气候模型以四十年来收集的观测数据为基础。

examples.en: Scholarships are awarded on the basis of academic promise rather than a family's social connections.
examples.zh: 奖学金的评定以学术潜力为依据，而不是看家庭的社会关系。

examples.en: Our debate team beat the defending champions at their own strategy of rapid questioning.
examples.zh: 我们的辩论队以卫冕冠军擅长的快速提问策略击败了他们。

meaning: 以...开始. to begin with (=first of all) 首先, 第一(经常用于开始语)

examples.en: Since the audience knew little about astronomy, Dr. Rao began with an explanation of how stars are born.
examples.zh: 由于听众对天文学了解不多，拉奥博士首先解释了恒星是如何诞生的。

examples.en: I am writing on behalf of my neighbors to object to the proposed closure of our only bus route.
examples.zh: 我谨代表邻居们写信，反对取消我们这里唯一一条公交线路的提议。

examples.en: A teacher who genuinely believes in her students can help them recover from an early failure.
examples.zh: 一位真正信任学生的老师能够帮助他们从早期的失败中振作起来。

examples.en: Restoring the wetlands would allow nearby farms to benefit from better flood control and healthier soil.
examples.zh: 恢复湿地能让附近农场受益于更有效的洪水控制和更健康的土壤。

examples.en: The museum installed low display cases for the benefit of children and visitors who use wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 博物馆安装了较低的展柜，以方便儿童和使用轮椅的参观者。

examples.en: Moving abroad was unsettling at first, yet it ultimately changed Lena's outlook for the better.
examples.zh: 移居国外起初令莉娜不安，但最终使她的人生观有了积极的改变。

examples.en: Although the negotiator intended to remain calm, impatience got the better of him during the final exchange.
examples.zh: 尽管那位谈判代表本想保持冷静，但在最后一轮交锋中还是被急躁情绪占了上风。

meaning: 在出生上,论出身,按血统 at birth 在出生时; give birth to 出生

examples.en: An engineer by training and a Kenyan by birth, Njoroge now writes novels about life in the Arctic.
examples.zh: 恩乔罗格受过工程师训练，出生于肯尼亚，如今却创作描写北极生活的小说。

meaning: 因...责备某人 . blame sth. on sb. 把...推在某人身上

examples.en: Residents blamed the contractor for blocking the only safe route to the hospital.
examples.zh: 居民指责承包商堵住了通往医院的唯一安全路线。

meaning: 开花(指树木) be in blossom 开花(强调状态) come into blossom 开花(强调动作)

examples.en: By late March, cherry trees across the university campus are usually in blossom.
examples.zh: 到三月底，大学校园里的樱花树通常都开花了。

meaning: 到船上, 在船上, 上火车或飞机

examples.en: Once everyone was on board, the research vessel left the harbor before dawn.
examples.zh: 所有人登船后，科考船在黎明前驶离了港口。

examples.en: The start-up boasts of using recycled materials, yet its packaging remains wasteful.
examples.zh: 这家初创企业吹嘘使用再生材料，但其包装仍然很浪费。

examples.en: Having climbed six flights during the power cut, the technician arrived out of breath.
examples.zh: 停电时爬了六层楼后，技术员气喘吁吁地赶到了。

examples.en: In brief, the reform lowers tuition fees without reducing teaching quality.
examples.zh: 简言之，这项改革在不降低教学质量的情况下降低了学费。

examples.en: Hospitals can reduce packaging costs by purchasing basic supplies in bulk.
examples.zh: 医院可以通过批量采购基本用品来降低包装成本。

examples.en: After listening quietly for an hour, the student representative took the floor.
examples.zh: 安静听了一个小时后，学生代表起身发言。

examples.en: Ms. Okafor is in Chengdu on business, negotiating a green-energy partnership.
examples.zh: 奥卡福女士正在成都出差，洽谈一项绿色能源合作。

meaning: 于某事 。 be busy doing sth. 忙于做某事

examples.en: While the engineers are busy with safety tests, the marketing launch will remain postponed.
examples.zh: 工程师们忙于安全测试期间，市场发布活动将继续推迟。

examples.en: The last but one chapter examines how automation changes entry-level work.
examples.zh: 倒数第二章探讨自动化如何改变初级岗位。

examples.en: But for a volunteer translator, the refugees could not have completed the health forms.
examples.zh: 要不是一名志愿译员，这些难民就无法填完健康表格。

examples.en: At the charity auction, Leon bought the signed photograph for very little money.
examples.zh: 在慈善拍卖会上，利昂花很少的钱买下了那张签名照片。

meaning: 能够, 有能力 be capable of being +过去分词:是能够被...的

examples.en: This portable scanner is capable of identifying structural damage beneath old paintings.
examples.zh: 这台便携式扫描仪能够识别古画表层下的结构损坏。

examples.en: The evidence is incomplete, but the agency must issue temporary guidance in any case.
examples.zh: 证据尚不完整，但无论如何，该机构都必须发布临时指导意见。

examples.en: Save an offline copy of your ticket in case the mobile network fails.
examples.zh: 保存一份车票的离线副本，以防移动网络出现故障。

meaning: 如果发生...万一 in the case of 至于..., 就...而言

examples.en: In case of chemical leakage, leave the laboratory and activate the alarm.
examples.zh: 如果发生化学品泄漏，请离开实验室并启动警报。

meaning: 在任何情况下都不(放句首倒装句)

examples.en: In no case may confidential interview recordings be shared without consent.
examples.zh: 任何情况下都不得未经同意分享机密访谈录音。

examples.en: Online shoppers should be cautious of reviews written by paid promoters.
examples.zh: 网购者应当警惕付费推广者撰写的评论。

meaning: 把某人的注意力集中在...上

examples.en: During the second trial, researchers centered their attention on the drug’s long-term effects.
examples.zh: 在第二次试验中，研究人员把注意力集中在该药物的长期影响上。

examples.en: Having repeated the calculation twice, Priya was certain of her result.
examples.zh: 普里娅把计算重复了两遍后，对自己的结果很有把握。

examples.en: We cannot know for certain whether the rare bird will return next spring.
examples.zh: 我们无法肯定这只珍稀鸟类明年春天是否会回来。

examples.en: By chance, a farmer’s photograph provided evidence of the valley’s former glacier.
examples.zh: 一位农民偶然拍下的照片提供了山谷曾有冰川的证据。

examples.en: After months of video conferences, the team met in a botanical garden for a change.
examples.zh: 在进行了几个月的视频会议后，团队换换环境，在植物园见了面。

examples.en: Federal prosecutors charged the software executive with stealing trade secrets.
examples.zh: 联邦检察官指控这名软件高管窃取商业机密。

meaning: 负责(某事) in the charge of ...由...管

examples.en: Who will be in charge of monitoring water quality once the project begins?
examples.zh: 项目启动后，谁将负责监测水质？

examples.en: When the director retired unexpectedly, her deputy took charge of the institute.
examples.zh: 主任意外退休后，她的副手接管了研究所。

meaning: 因...索取(费用) , charge sb. with sth. 控告某人犯有...

examples.en: The platform charges small businesses a fixed fee for each international payment.
examples.zh: 该平台对小企业的每笔国际付款收取固定费用。

examples.en: Emergency crews worked round the clock to reconnect mountain villages to the power grid.
examples.zh: 应急人员昼夜不停地工作，使山村重新接入电网。

examples.en: Several historians declined to comment on the authenticity of the newly found diary.
examples.zh: 几位历史学家拒绝评论新发现日记的真伪。

meaning: 使自己承担... commit sb. to prison 把某人送进监狱; commit one's idea to writing 把某人的想法写下来; commit a matter to a committee 把某事交给委员会讨论

examples.en: By signing the climate pledge, each company commits itself to publishing annual emissions data.
examples.zh: 每家公司签署气候承诺，即表示承担每年公布排放数据的责任。

meaning: 和...)有共同之处,共用. be common to sb. 是与某人所共有的

examples.en: Despite different backgrounds, the two economists have a concern for social equality in common.
examples.zh: 尽管背景不同，这两位经济学家都关注社会平等。

examples.en: People who keep company with creative colleagues may become more willing to question assumptions.
examples.zh: 与富有创造力的同事经常来往的人可能更愿意质疑既有假设。

examples.en: Before drawing conclusions, compare the rural employment figures with the national average.
examples.zh: 在得出结论前，把农村就业数据与全国平均水平作比较。

examples.en: The novelist compares the crowded railway station to a restless ocean.
examples.zh: 小说家把拥挤的火车站比作躁动的海洋。

examples.en: Solar power seems costly at first; by comparison, its operating expenses are low.
examples.zh: 太阳能起初似乎成本高；比较起来，其运营费用很低。

examples.en: In comparison with face-to-face therapy, the online service reaches more isolated patients.
examples.zh: 与面对面治疗相比，这项在线服务能覆盖更多与外界隔绝的患者。

meaning: 补偿, 赔偿,弥补 compensate sb. for sth. 赔偿, 弥补

examples.en: A shorter working week may compensate for the stress caused by rapid organizational change.
examples.zh: 缩短工作周或许能弥补组织快速变革造成的压力。

meaning: 抱怨;诉苦;控告;complain about 抱怨某人或事情; complain to sb. about sth. (or sb.) 向某人抱怨...; complain (抱怨); complement (补充); compliment (恭维)

examples.en: Rather than complain about the outdated system, the interns designed a simpler one.
examples.zh: 实习生们没有抱怨过时的系统，而是设计了一个更简单的系统。

examples.en: Manufacturers that fail to comply with the new standard will lose their licenses.
examples.zh: 不遵守新标准的制造商将被吊销许可证。

examples.en: A century ago, few citizens could conceive of attending a university lecture from home.
examples.zh: 一个世纪前，很少有人能设想在家听大学讲座。

examples.en: To meet the deadline, the analysts concentrated on the three most reliable indicators.
examples.zh: 为了赶上截止日期，分析师们集中研究三个最可靠的指标。

examples.en: This branch of sociology is concerned with the effects of migration on family life.
examples.zh: 社会学的这一分支研究移民对家庭生活的影响。

examples.en: A good mentor concerns herself with a junior colleague’s development, not merely output.
examples.zh: 好导师关心年轻同事的发展，而不仅仅是产出。

meaning: 最后一点; at the conclusion of 当...结束时;

examples.en: In conclusion, equal access to education requires more than lowering tuition.
examples.zh: 最后，教育机会平等所需要的不只是降低学费。

examples.en: The military court condemned the officer to ten years in prison for selling state secrets.
examples.zh: 军事法庭判处这名出卖国家机密的军官十年监禁。

meaning: 以...为条件, 假如. in that = because 因为; now that = since 既然 for all that = although 尽管

examples.en: The publisher will release the images on condition that the museum is properly credited.
examples.zh: 出版商将在博物馆得到恰当署名的条件下发布这些图像。

meaning: 健康状况好/不好 . in good (bad) condition 处于良好(坏)状态

examples.en: Although the laptop looks new, its battery is in poor condition.
examples.zh: 虽然这台笔记本电脑看起来很新，但电池状况很差。

meaning: 承认, 供认; confess to a crime 承认罪行.

examples.en: Under questioning, the accountant confessed to altering several expense records.
examples.zh: 在讯问中，这名会计承认篡改了几份费用记录。

examples.en: Many first-year students find it easier to confide in a peer adviser than a professor.
examples.zh: 许多大一学生觉得向同伴顾问吐露心声比向教授更容易。

meaning: 推心置腹地; with confidence 满怀信心地; have confidence in 对...有信心

examples.en: The scientist shared the preliminary results with her colleague in confidence.
examples.zh: 这位科学家私下把初步结果告诉了同事。

examples.en: Transparent pricing can restore public confidence in the health insurance market.
examples.zh: 透明定价可以恢复公众对健康保险市场的信心。

meaning: 有信心; confidential 机密的

examples.en: After successful field tests, the engineers are confident of the bridge design’s safety.
examples.zh: 成功完成现场测试后，工程师们对桥梁设计的安全性有信心。

examples.en: The pilot program confines free legal advice to households below a fixed income.
examples.zh: 这项试点计划把免费法律咨询限定于收入低于固定标准的家庭。

examples.en: A month among skilled nurses confirmed Ella in her desire to study medicine.
examples.zh: 与熟练护士共事一个月，更坚定了埃拉学医的愿望。

meaning: 符合,遵照,遵守;1)obey 服从; 2) observe; 3)comply with 照...办; 4)keep to 遵循; 5)abide by 服从;6)stick to 按..做

examples.en: All imported toys must conform to the country’s updated safety code.
examples.zh: 所有进口玩具都必须符合该国更新后的安全规范。

examples.en: Confronted with a shortage of teachers, the county offered housing subsidies to new graduates.
examples.zh: 面对教师短缺，该县向应届毕业生提供住房补贴。

examples.en: The dean congratulated the robotics club on winning an international award.
examples.zh: 院长祝贺机器人社团赢得国际奖项。

examples.en: Police interviewed three contractors in connection with the collapsed footbridge.
examples.zh: 警方就人行桥坍塌一事询问了三名承包商。

examples.en: Speaking through an interpreter made the patient conscious of every pause in the conversation.
examples.zh: 通过口译员交谈使患者觉察到对话中的每一次停顿。

examples.en: Only half of the participants consented to having their genetic data stored.
examples.zh: 只有一半参与者同意保存他们的基因数据。

examples.en: The reservoir fell below a critical level; in consequence, water use was restricted.
examples.zh: 水库水位降至临界线以下；因此，用水受到了限制。

examples.en: Several crops failed in consequence of unusually cold summer nights.
examples.zh: 由于夏夜异常寒冷，几种农作物歉收。

examples.en: A proposal to extend paid parental leave is currently under consideration.
examples.zh: 延长带薪育儿假的提案目前正在审议中。

examples.en: In consideration of the neighborhood’s historical character, planners lowered the new buildings.
examples.zh: 考虑到街区的历史特色，规划者降低了新建筑的高度。

examples.en: On no consideration should financial pressure influence a doctor’s diagnosis.
examples.zh: 无论如何，经济压力都不应影响医生的诊断。

meaning: 考虑到, 把...考虑进去

examples.en: The scholarship panel took each applicant’s family circumstances into consideration.
examples.zh: 奖学金评审小组考虑了每位申请人的家庭情况。

meaning: 体贴的, 考虑他人需要的, considerable 相当大的,值 得考虑的

examples.en: It was considerate of the manager to provide a quiet room for nursing mothers.
examples.zh: 经理为哺乳期母亲提供安静房间，十分体贴。

meaning: 由...组成的. consist in 主要在于. consist with 符合,与...一致

examples.en: The digital archive consists of photographs, letters, maps, and recorded interviews.
examples.zh: 这个数字档案由照片、信件、地图和录音访谈组成。

meaning: 与...一致. be consistent in 一贯的,

examples.en: A ban on disposable plastics would be consistent with the university’s sustainability pledge.
examples.zh: 禁止一次性塑料制品将与大学的可持续发展承诺一致。

meaning: 向...征求...方面的意见, 就...向...请教

examples.en: Before changing her medication, Rosa consulted a specialist about the possible side effects.
examples.zh: 罗莎在换药前就可能的副作用咨询了专家。

examples.en: Once the final exam ended, the students explored the science museum to their hearts’ content.
examples.zh: 期末考试结束后，学生们在科学博物馆尽情参观。

meaning: 满足于 be content to do sth. 愿意做某事

examples.en: Citizens should not be content with an air-quality target that still permits harmful pollution.
examples.zh: 市民不应满足于一个仍允许有害污染存在的空气质量目标。

examples.en: Contrary to popular belief, older employees can adapt quickly to new software.
examples.zh: 与普遍看法相反，年长员工能够迅速适应新软件。

examples.en: The new rules will not hinder innovation; on the contrary, they may encourage safer designs.
examples.zh: 新规定不会阻碍创新；相反，它们可能促进更安全的设计。

examples.en: The documentary contrasts the wealth of the capital with hardship in former mining towns.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片把首都的富裕与昔日矿区城镇的困境进行对照。

meaning: 和...形成对比 by contrast 对比之下

examples.en: In contrast to conventional farms, this greenhouse uses almost no chemical pesticide.
examples.zh: 与传统农场相比，这座温室几乎不使用化学农药。

examples.en: Reliable childcare can contribute to greater economic independence for women.
examples.zh: 可靠的托育服务有助于提高女性的经济独立性。

meaning: 被)控制住 out of control无法控制

examples.en: Firefighters brought the forest blaze under control shortly before the wind strengthened.
examples.zh: 消防员在风力增强前不久控制住了森林大火。

meaning: 在方便的时间或地点 . be convenient to / for 对...方便

examples.en: You may inspect the original survey records at your convenience.
examples.zh: 你可以在方便的时候查阅原始调查记录。

meaning: 使某人确信,try to persuade sb. to do sth.劝说某人做...

examples.en: Satellite images convinced the authorities of the need for immediate flood defenses.
examples.zh: 卫星图像使当局确信有必要立即建设防洪设施。

examples.en: Small museums often struggle to cope with the cost of preserving digital collections.
examples.zh: 小型博物馆常常难以应对保存数字藏品的成本。

meaning: 在角落里;on(at) the comer of a street 在街道拐弯处;round the comer 拐过 弯; be in a tight corner 陷入困境

examples.en: A solar-powered reading lamp stood in the corner of the temporary classroom.
examples.zh: 临时教室的角落里放着一盏太阳能阅读灯。

examples.en: For years, the marine biologist corresponded with fishermen who recorded whale sightings.
examples.zh: 多年来，这位海洋生物学家一直与记录鲸鱼目击情况的渔民通信。

meaning: 相当于 . correspond with 符合,一致

examples.en: Each colored line on the map corresponds to a different level of earthquake risk.
examples.zh: 地图上的每条彩线都对应不同的地震风险等级。

meaning: 不惜任何代价 . at the cost of 以...为代价

examples.en: The rescue leader promised to reach the trapped climbers at all costs.
examples.zh: 救援队长承诺不惜一切代价营救被困的登山者。

examples.en: In a well-run laboratory, recording every sample is a matter of course.
examples.zh: 在管理良好的实验室里，记录每份样本是理所当然的事。

examples.en: New employees receive cybersecurity training as a matter of course.
examples.zh: 新员工自然都会接受网络安全培训。

examples.en: During the course of the investigation, auditors uncovered a second source of missing funds.
examples.zh: 在调查过程中，审计人员发现了第二个资金流失源头。

meaning: 没经过太久, 到一定时候

examples.en: If the treatment proves safe, it will become available to other patients in due course.
examples.zh: 如果这种治疗被证明安全，其他患者到时候也能使用。

meaning: 赊购; with credit 以优异成绩; to one's credit 使某人感到光荣; do sb. credit 使... 感到光荣

examples.en: Unable to pay cash, the family bought the energy-efficient refrigerator on credit.
examples.zh: 由于无法支付现金，这家人赊购了那台节能冰箱。

examples.en: Several reviewers were critical of the study’s narrow definition of poverty.
examples.zh: 几位评审者批评该研究对贫困的定义过于狭窄。

meaning: 某种疾病 治好某人的疾病

examples.en: A short course of antibiotics cured the child of the bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 短期抗生素疗程治好了孩子的细菌感染。

meaning: 对...的危险; be in danger(of)处于...危险中; be out of danger 脱离危险

examples.en: False medical advice online can be a danger to people with chronic illnesses.
examples.zh: 网上的虚假医疗建议可能对慢性病患者构成危险。

examples.en: To date, no battery tested by the laboratory has met all five safety requirements.
examples.zh: 迄今为止，该实验室测试的电池没有一款满足全部五项安全要求。

meaning: 过时的；up to date 新式的,时兴的; date back to 可追溯到; date from 从某时期 开始(有)

examples.en: Printed bus schedules quickly become out of date when routes change frequently.
examples.zh: 公交线路频繁调整时，印刷版时刻表很快就会过时。

examples.en: The final chapter deals with ethical questions raised by artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 最后一章论述人工智能引发的伦理问题。

examples.en: Modern genetics is deeply in debt to the patients who donated tissue for research.
examples.zh: 现代遗传学深受那些为研究捐献组织的患者之惠。

meaning: 在衰退中, 在减少中 in decline 下降; on the increase 在增加

examples.en: Since stricter limits were introduced, the use of coal in the region has been on the decline.
examples.zh: 自从实施更严格的限制以来，该地区的煤炭使用量一直在下降。

meaning: 令某人感到高兴 to one's regret 遗憾; sorrow 悲痛; relief 安心; distress 苦恼; shame 羞愧; surprise 惊奇; astonishment 惊奇;

examples.en: To the conservator’s delight, the faded inscription became visible under ultraviolet light.
examples.zh: 令文物修复师高兴的是，褪色的铭文在紫外光下显现出来。

examples.en: Some mathematicians delight in solving problems that appear to have no practical use.
examples.zh: 一些数学家喜欢解决看似没有实际用途的问题。

examples.en: The retired carpenter takes a delight in teaching traditional skills to local teenagers.
examples.zh: 这位退休木匠以向当地青少年传授传统技艺为乐。

meaning: 向某人要求(非物质的)东西. demand sth. from sb. 向某人要求(物质的) 东西

examples.en: A career in public health demands both scientific judgment and empathy of its practitioners.
examples.zh: 公共卫生事业要求从业者兼具科学判断力和同理心。

meaning: 有需求;on demand 受到要求时

examples.en: Data analysts with experience in machine learning remain in strong demand.
examples.zh: 具有机器学习经验的数据分析师仍然很抢手。

examples.en: Food production in this dry region is heavily dependent on efficient irrigation.
examples.zh: 这个干旱地区的粮食生产高度依赖高效灌溉。

examples.en: Closing the village school would deprive children of daily contact with trained teachers.
examples.zh: 关闭村里的学校会剥夺孩子们每天接触受过专业训练的教师的机会。

meaning: 从...取得,由...来的.derive from(=come from)起源于

examples.en: The medicine derives its distinctive smell from an oil found in citrus peel.
examples.zh: 这种药独特的气味来自柑橘皮中的一种油。

examples.en: Although funding was repeatedly refused, the researcher did not despair of finding a cure.
examples.zh: 尽管资助屡遭拒绝，这名研究人员并未对找到治疗方法绝望。

examples.en: In despair, several shop owners considered abandoning the flood-damaged town.
examples.zh: 绝望之中，几位店主考虑离开遭洪水破坏的小镇。

examples.en: Despite fierce opposition, the council reserved half the new apartments for low-income families.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，市议会仍把一半新公寓留给低收入家庭。

examples.en: The witness described in detail how the safety alarm had been disabled.
examples.zh: 证人详细描述了安全警报是如何被关闭的。

examples.en: Any algorithm that deviates from the approved medical protocol must alert a human doctor.
examples.zh: 任何偏离获批医疗规程的算法都必须提醒真人医生。

meaning: 吃某种特殊饮食, 节食

examples.en: On her doctor’s advice, Fatima went on a low-salt diet to control her blood pressure.
examples.zh: 在医生建议下，法蒂玛开始低盐饮食以控制血压。

examples.en: Electric vehicles differ from petrol cars in how they store and deliver energy.
examples.zh: 电动汽车与燃油汽车的区别在于储存和输送能量的方式。

examples.en: When the export market collapsed, many family-owned workshops found themselves in difficulties.
examples.zh: 出口市场崩溃时，许多家庭作坊陷入困境。

examples.en: The airline discharged the mechanic from service for repeatedly ignoring safety checks.
examples.zh: 航空公司因这名机械师屡次无视安全检查而将其解雇。

meaning: 撤退; in disorder 慌乱地, 狼狈不堪

examples.en: As the fire advanced, wildlife officers fell back to a safer observation point.
examples.zh: 随着大火逼近，野生动物保护人员撤退到更安全的观察点。

examples.en: A prototype made from ocean plastic is on display at the design museum.
examples.zh: 一个由海洋塑料制成的原型正在设计博物馆展出。

examples.en: Clinics need a secure method to dispose of expired medicines and used needles.
examples.zh: 诊所需要一种安全方法来处理过期药品和使用过的针头。

examples.en: The economic value of protecting this source of drinking water is beyond dispute.
examples.zh: 保护这一饮用水源的经济价值不容争议。

examples.en: Ownership of the land remains in dispute despite years of negotiation.
examples.zh: 尽管谈判多年，这片土地的所有权仍有争议。

meaning: 在远处. make out 辩认出

examples.en: Beyond the wind turbines, snow-covered mountains rose in the distance.
examples.zh: 越过风力涡轮机，远处耸立着白雪覆盖的群山。

examples.en: Digital literacy is distinct from merely knowing how to operate a smartphone.
examples.zh: 数字素养与仅仅知道如何操作智能手机截然不同。

examples.en: The course teaches readers to distinguish between verified journalism and sponsored content.
examples.zh: 这门课程教读者辨别经核实的新闻与赞助内容。

examples.en: A chemical marker enables inspectors to distinguish recycled cotton from newly produced fiber.
examples.zh: 一种化学标记使检查人员能够把再生棉与新生产的纤维区别开来。

meaning: 除去,废除,取消; do away with (=kill) 杀掉, 镇压

examples.en: Several cities have done away with parking minimums to encourage public transport.
examples.zh: 几个城市已经取消最低停车位要求，以鼓励使用公共交通。

examples.en: The fall in productivity may have more to do with poor management than remote work.
examples.zh: 生产率下降可能更多与管理不善有关，而不是远程工作。

examples.en: Without doubt, clean water infrastructure is among the century’s greatest public-health achievements.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，清洁供水基础设施是本世纪最伟大的公共卫生成就之一。

examples.en: If the sensor readings remain in doubt, technicians will repeat the field test.
examples.zh: 如果传感器读数仍有疑问，技术人员将重复现场测试。

examples.en: The decline in childhood infections was largely due to wider vaccine coverage.
examples.zh: 儿童感染率下降主要是由于疫苗覆盖面扩大。

examples.en: When Marta came off duty at sunrise, the emergency ward was finally quiet.
examples.zh: 玛尔塔日出时下班，急诊病房终于安静下来。

examples.en: A second team of engineers will go on duty when the night shift begins.
examples.zh: 夜班开始时，第二组工程师将上班。

meaning: 值班, 值日, 在上班时

examples.en: Because the regular technician is ill, I am on duty in the control room tonight.
examples.zh: 因为常规技术员生病了，今晚我在控制室值班。

phrase: be in duty bound to do

examples.en: As licensed professionals, architects are in duty bound to report serious structural risks.
examples.zh: 作为持证专业人员，建筑师有义务报告严重的结构风险。

examples.en: After years of temporary contracts, the young scientist was eager for a permanent research post.
examples.zh: 做了多年临时合同工后，这位年轻科学家渴望得到一个长期研究职位。

examples.en: Unable to read music, the folk singer learned every melody by ear.
examples.zh: 这位民歌手不识乐谱，每段旋律都是凭听觉学会的。

examples.en: A skilled editor has an ear for dialogue that sounds unnatural on the page.
examples.zh: 优秀的编辑善于听辨书面上显得不自然的对白。

examples.en: Before the broadcast began, the producer had a quiet word in the presenter’s ear.
examples.zh: 直播开始前，制片人悄悄对主持人说了几句话。

meaning: 究竟, 到底, 全然

examples.en: How on earth can a city cut traffic emissions without improving public transport?
examples.zh: 一个城市究竟怎么能在不改善公共交通的情况下减少交通排放呢？

examples.en: Thanks to voice-recognition software, users can search the archive with ease.
examples.zh: 借助语音识别软件，用户可以轻松检索档案。

examples.en: Surrounded by supportive classmates, the exchange student soon felt at ease.
examples.zh: 在友善同学的陪伴下，这名交换生很快就感到自在了。

examples.en: The counselor began with an informal question to put the anxious teenager at her ease.
examples.zh: 咨询师先问了一个轻松的问题，让焦虑的少女放松下来。

examples.en: To afford the field trip, Maya economized on meals out for three months.
examples.zh: 为了支付实地考察费用，玛雅连续三个月减少了外出就餐的开支。

examples.en: Even brief exposure to daylight can have an effect on a patient's sleep cycle.
examples.zh: 即使短暂接触日光，也会对患者的睡眠周期产生影响。

examples.en: A temporary ban on fishing is now in effect along the northern coast.
examples.zh: 北部沿海地区目前正在实施临时禁渔令。

meaning: 生效. ( 近: come into effect; take effect; be brought into effect)

examples.en: The revised parking fees will go into effect at midnight on Friday.
examples.zh: 修订后的停车费将于周五午夜生效。

examples.en: By refusing to answer, the witness in effect admitted that he knew about the payment.
examples.zh: 证人拒绝回答，实际上等于承认自己知道那笔款项。

examples.en: New funding will give effect to the city's ambitious plan for cleaner buses.
examples.zh: 新增资金将使该市雄心勃勃的清洁公交计划得以实施。

meaning: 不起作用,没有取得任何效果

examples.en: Nora knocked repeatedly on the laboratory door, but to no effect.
examples.zh: 诺拉反复敲实验室的门，却毫无作用。

examples.en: Without the director's signature, this agreement will be of no effect.
examples.zh: 没有主任签字，这份协议将不具效力。

examples.en: Residents received a notice to the effect that the bridge would close for repairs.
examples.zh: 居民收到一份通知，大意是这座桥将封闭维修。

examples.en: The dean promised greater support for rural students and issued a statement to that effect.
examples.zh: 院长承诺为农村学生提供更多支持，并发布了相关声明。

meaning: 出现, 暴露(问题. 意见等)

examples.en: A surprisingly hopeful picture emerged from the interviews with unemployed graduates.
examples.zh: 对失业毕业生的访谈呈现出一幅出人意料的乐观图景。

phrase: place(or put, lay) an emphasis on
meaning: 强调, 把重点放在...上

examples.en: Unlike earlier courses, this workshop places an emphasis on practical negotiation skills.
examples.zh: 与以往课程不同，这次研习班强调实用的谈判技巧。

meaning: 鼓励; encourage sb. in his/her work 鼓励某人工作; encourage sb. in his/her idleness 怂恿某人游手好闲

examples.en: Her coach encouraged Lina in her ambition to compete internationally.
examples.zh: 教练鼓励莉娜追求参加国际比赛的志向。

examples.en: The editor encouraged the novice in his writing with detailed, constructive comments.
examples.zh: 编辑用详尽而有建设性的意见鼓励这位新手继续写作。

examples.en: During the drought, some villages went without running water for days on end.
examples.zh: 干旱期间，一些村庄连续多日没有自来水。

examples.en: Once the final passenger stepped ashore, the long rescue operation was at an end.
examples.zh: 最后一名乘客上岸后，漫长的救援行动便结束了。

examples.en: The misleading label caused no end of confusion among elderly customers.
examples.zh: 这个误导性标签给老年顾客造成了无数困惑。

examples.en: Though several prototypes failed, the engineers found a workable design in the end.
examples.zh: 尽管几个原型都失败了，工程师们最终还是找到了可行的设计。

meaning: 无法可想, 智穷计尽

examples.en: Unable to calm the crying infant, the exhausted father was at his wit's end.
examples.zh: 筋疲力尽的父亲怎么也哄不好哭闹的婴儿，已经束手无策。

examples.en: If you ignore minor cracks, you may end up with a costly structural problem.
examples.zh: 如果忽视细小裂缝，最终可能会面临代价高昂的结构问题。

examples.en: As the monsoon came to an end, farmers returned to the flooded fields.
examples.zh: 随着雨季结束，农民们回到了被淹的田地。

examples.en: What began as a friendly debate ended in a bitter personal quarrel.
examples.zh: 一场起初友好的辩论最终以激烈的人身争吵告终。

meaning: 或 be engaged in 忙于,从事

examples.en: Students who engage in regular exercise tend to cope better with academic pressure.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼的学生往往更能应对学业压力。

examples.en: Priya entered her documentary for an international film award.
examples.zh: 普里娅报名让自己的纪录片角逐一项国际电影奖。

examples.en: The investigators refused to enter into speculation before examining the wreckage.
examples.zh: 调查人员在检查残骸前拒绝进行推测。

meaning: 开始 (一个时代. 一种涯. 一段任期等)

examples.en: At sixty, Chen entered upon a new career as a landscape photographer.
examples.zh: 陈先生六十岁时开始了风景摄影师的新生涯。

examples.en: Every temporary worker is entitled to a safe and respectful workplace.
examples.zh: 每名临时工都有权享有安全且受到尊重的工作环境。

examples.en: The old generator proved equal to the demands of the emergency shelter.
examples.zh: 事实证明，这台旧发电机能够满足应急避难所的需要。

meaning: 某人)能胜任,能应付 on equal terms(=on and equal footing)平等地

examples.en: After a night's rest, I finally felt equal to the steep mountain climb.
examples.zh: 休息一夜后，我终于觉得自己能够胜任这次陡峭的登山行程。

examples.en: Each ambulance is equipped with a portable heart monitor.
examples.zh: 每辆救护车都配备了一台便携式心脏监护仪。

examples.en: For a small island, losing the ferry would be equivalent to losing its economic lifeline.
examples.zh: 对一座小岛来说，失去渡船就等于失去经济命脉。

examples.en: In essence, the novel asks whether memory can be trusted.
examples.zh: 从本质上说，这部小说追问的是记忆是否可信。

meaning: 不论怎样, 无论如何

examples.en: At all events, the museum must protect the paintings from further damp.
examples.zh: 无论如何，博物馆都必须保护这些画作免受进一步的潮气侵害。

meaning: 无论如何, 不管(将来)怎么样

examples.en: The outdoor concert may be postponed; in any event, tickets will remain valid.
examples.zh: 露天音乐会可能延期；无论如何，门票仍然有效。

meaning: 假如, 如果. in the event 结果, 实际情况是(常与 but 连用)

examples.en: Keep this emergency number nearby in the event that the child develops a fever.
examples.zh: 把这个急救电话号码放在手边，以防孩子发烧。

examples.en: In the event of an earthquake, passengers should move away from glass doors.
examples.zh: 如果发生地震，乘客应远离玻璃门。

meaning: 除...以外; besides 除...以外还有..；除了。

examples.en: The café opens every morning except Sunday.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆除周日外每天早晨营业。

examples.en: Except for a faint scar, her injured hand has fully recovered.
examples.zh: 除了一道浅浅的疤痕，她受伤的手已经完全康复。

examples.en: The warm February afternoon was an exception to the region's usually harsh winter.
examples.zh: 二月里这个温暖的下午，是当地通常严寒冬季中的一个例外。

examples.en: With the exception of two remote farms, electricity has returned throughout the valley.
examples.zh: 除了两座偏远农场，整个山谷都已恢复供电。

examples.en: Restoring the ancient theatre is expected to cost in excess of ten million yuan.
examples.zh: 修复这座古剧院预计将耗资一千万元以上。

examples.en: At the border station, travelers can exchange euros for local currency.
examples.zh: 旅客可以在边境站把欧元兑换成当地货币。

examples.en: The quoted rent is 4,000 yuan a month, exclusive of heating and water.
examples.zh: 报价的租金为每月四千元，不包括暖气费和水费。

examples.en: Nothing can be said in excuse of deliberately hiding a safety defect.
examples.zh: 任何理由都不能为故意隐瞒安全缺陷开脱。

examples.en: High expectations can exert enormous pressure on first-generation university students.
examples.zh: 过高的期望会给第一代大学生带来巨大压力。

examples.en: Although feverish, the nurse exerted herself to reassure the frightened patient.
examples.zh: 尽管发着烧，这名护士仍尽力安慰受惊的患者。

meaning: 开始存在; come into use 开始使用; come into effect 开 始运转; come into fashion 开始时新; come into action 开始行动; come into power 开始执政; come into sight 进入视野;come into blossom 开花;

examples.en: The coastal wetland came into existence after decades of sediment accumulation.
examples.zh: 这片滨海湿地经过数十年的泥沙沉积才形成。

meaning: 存在 come into existence 出现

examples.en: Written records prove that the market was in existence six centuries ago.
examples.zh: 文字记录证明，这个市场六百年前就已存在。

examples.en: Patience and accuracy are qualities we expect of every air-traffic controller.
examples.zh: 耐心和准确是我们期望每位空中交通管制员具备的品质。

meaning: 在损害...情况下,以...为牺牲

examples.en: Rapid growth should not come at the expense of workers' health.
examples.zh: 快速增长不应以牺牲工人的健康为代价。

meaning: 使暴露于..., 使...受(危险,风险)

examples.en: Opening the container may expose laboratory staff to a toxic gas.
examples.zh: 打开容器可能会使实验室人员接触有毒气体。

examples.en: Children living near the highway are exposed to constant traffic noise.
examples.zh: 住在高速公路附近的儿童长期暴露在交通噪声中。

meaning: 无法形容, 说不出的

examples.en: The relief on the missing climber's face was beyond expression.
examples.zh: 那名失踪登山者脸上的如释重负之情难以言表。

meaning: 表达, 表现 find expression in 表现

examples.en: Her sculpture gives expression to the loneliness of urban life.
examples.zh: 她的雕塑表现了城市生活中的孤独感。

examples.en: To some extent, online anonymity allows shy people to speak more freely.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，网络匿名使害羞的人能够更自由地发言。

examples.en: Leaving an injured hiker alone in such weather would be dangerous in the extreme.
examples.zh: 在这种天气里把受伤的徒步者独自留下会极其危险。

examples.en: The apprentice looked his master in the eye and admitted the costly mistake.
examples.zh: 学徒直视师傅的眼睛，承认了那个代价高昂的错误。

examples.en: We cannot shut our eyes to the widening gap in access to medical care.
examples.zh: 我们不能对医疗资源获取差距的扩大视而不见。

meaning: 在心目中, 在想象中

examples.en: In his mind's eye, the architect saw sunlight pouring through the unfinished roof.
examples.zh: 在想象中，建筑师看见阳光穿过尚未完工的屋顶倾泻而下。

phrase: in the twinkling of an eye

examples.en: In the twinkling of an eye, the curious fox vanished into the wheat field.
examples.zh: 转眼之间，那只好奇的狐狸便消失在麦田里。

examples.en: Could you keep an eye on my luggage while I buy the tickets?
examples.zh: 我去买票时，你能帮我照看一下行李吗？

phrase: in the eyes of in one's eyes
meaning: 在某人看来, 在某人眼里

examples.en: In her children's eyes, the village doctor could solve any problem.
examples.zh: 在她的孩子们眼中，这位乡村医生什么问题都能解决。

examples.en: On the face of it, the job offers freedom, but the hours are strictly controlled.
examples.zh: 表面上看，这份工作很自由，但工作时间受到严格控制。

examples.en: The tiny bookstore survived in the face of fierce competition from online retailers.
examples.zh: 面对网络零售商的激烈竞争，这家小书店生存了下来。

meaning: 当着某人的面; face to faced 面对面; face up to 大胆面向

examples.en: A gust slammed the loose window in my face as I leaned outside.
examples.zh: 我探身窗外时，一阵风把松动的窗户猛地甩到我面前。

examples.en: The charity failed in its attempt to secure long-term funding.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构争取长期资金的尝试失败了。

examples.en: Both landlords signed the revised contract in good faith.
examples.zh: 两位房东都真诚地签署了修订后的合同。

examples.en: A responsible government must keep faith with citizens who supported the reform.
examples.zh: 负责任的政府必须对支持改革的公民信守承诺。

examples.en: After three unexplained delays, investors began to lose faith in the project.
examples.zh: 三次无故延期后，投资者开始对该项目失去信心。

meaning: 毫无怀疑地, 依赖地

examples.en: Never accept a health claim on faith merely because a celebrity repeats it.
examples.zh: 不要仅仅因为名人反复宣传，就不加怀疑地相信某种健康说法。

examples.en: Even under commercial pressure, the research team remained faithful to its commitment to publish negative findings.
examples.zh: 即使面临商业压力，该研究团队仍忠实履行公布负面研究结果的承诺。

examples.en: Remote workers can easily fall into the habit of answering emails late at night.
examples.zh: 远程工作者很容易养成深夜回复邮件的习惯。

meaning: 没达到, 低于；达不到

examples.en: Last winter's rainfall fell far short of the amount needed to refill the reservoir.
examples.zh: 去年冬天的降雨量远未达到水库蓄满所需的水平。

examples.en: Before operating the crane, make sure you are familiar with every safety control.
examples.zh: 操作起重机前，务必熟悉每一个安全控制装置。

meaning: 没有道理地)喜欢, 想要

examples.en: My grandfather has a fancy for repairing clocks that everyone else has abandoned.
examples.zh: 我祖父喜欢修理别人都不要的钟表。

examples.en: A stray kitten took a fancy to the warm corner beside our bakery.
examples.zh: 一只流浪小猫喜欢上了我们面包店旁那个温暖的角落。

meaning: 远, 非常 (与比较级或最高级连用)

examples.en: Among the proposed routes, the riverside path is by far the safest.
examples.zh: 在提议的路线中，河边小路安全得多。

examples.en: Far from easing congestion, the new lane created another bottleneck.
examples.zh: 新车道非但没有缓解拥堵，反而造成了另一个瓶颈。

examples.en: Handwritten wedding invitations are suddenly in fashion again.
examples.zh: 手写婚礼请柬突然又流行起来了。

examples.en: The courtyard was designed after the fashion of a traditional Suzhou garden.
examples.zh: 这座庭院仿照传统苏州园林的风格设计。

examples.en: No matter how carefully I cook, my uncle always finds fault with the seasoning.
examples.zh: 无论我做饭多么用心，叔叔总要挑调味的毛病。

examples.en: Investigators concluded that a defective valve, not the operator, was at fault.
examples.zh: 调查人员认定，问题出在一个有缺陷的阀门，而非操作员。

examples.en: Most residents voted in favour of turning the vacant lot into a playground.
examples.zh: 大多数居民投票赞成把空地改造成游乐场。

meaning: 受宠, 受偏爱; out of favour with 失宠, 不受宠

examples.en: Simple linen jackets are currently in favour with young office workers.
examples.zh: 简洁的亚麻夹克目前很受年轻上班族欢迎。

examples.en: Her fluency in Arabic worked strongly in her favour during the interview.
examples.zh: 她流利的阿拉伯语在面试中成为一项明显优势。

examples.en: Cool nights and sunny days are favourable to the growth of these grapes.
examples.zh: 凉爽的夜晚和晴朗的白天有利于这些葡萄生长。

examples.en: Families fear for the sailors still missing after the storm.
examples.zh: 家属们为暴风雨后仍然失踪的水手担忧。

examples.en: He whispered the password for fear of being overheard.
examples.zh: 他低声说出口令，生怕被人听见。

examples.en: For years, shopkeepers lived in fear of another devastating flood.
examples.zh: 多年来，店主们一直生活在对另一场毁灭性洪水的恐惧中。

examples.en: The rehabilitation center feeds rescued owls on small fish and insects.
examples.zh: 康复中心用小鱼和昆虫喂养获救的猫头鹰。

examples.en: Commuters are fed up with excuses for the railway's constant delays.
examples.zh: 通勤者受够了铁路方面为不断晚点所找的借口。

examples.en: After six hours underground, the miners felt like breathing fresh air more than anything.
examples.zh: 在地下待了六小时后，矿工们最想做的就是呼吸新鲜空气。

examples.en: Please fill in the emergency contact section before signing the form.
examples.zh: 请在签表前填写紧急联系人一栏。

examples.en: Applicants must fill out a separate questionnaire about previous work experience.
examples.zh: 申请人必须填写一份有关以往工作经历的单独问卷。

phrase: set the world on fire=set the flames on fire

examples.en: The debut album did not set the world on fire, yet it revealed a distinctive voice.
examples.zh: 这张首发专辑虽未引起轰动，却展现出独特的声音。

examples.en: A bank that conceals major losses from regulators is playing with fire.
examples.zh: 一家向监管机构隐瞒巨额亏损的银行是在玩火。

examples.en: A spark from the machine set a pile of dry cloth on fire.
examples.zh: 机器迸出的火花点燃了一堆干布。

examples.en: At first sight, the fossil resembled an ordinary piece of grey stone.
examples.zh: 乍看之下，这块化石像一块普通的灰色石头。

examples.en: For the first time, blind visitors can touch replicas of the museum's sculptures.
examples.zh: 盲人参观者首次可以触摸博物馆雕塑的复制品。

examples.en: Why did the hospital store sensitive records on an unsecured server in the first place?
examples.zh: 医院当初为什么要把敏感记录存放在不安全的服务器上？

examples.en: The narrow bookshelf fits neatly into the space beneath the stairs.
examples.zh: 这个窄书架正好嵌入楼梯下方的空间。

meaning: 合适, 相配, 一致

examples.en: Solar panels fit in with the community's goal of reducing carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 太阳能板符合社区减少碳排放的目标。

examples.en: After extensive repairs, the old ferry is finally fit for service again.
examples.zh: 经过大修，这艘旧渡船终于可以重新投入使用了。

meaning: 集中在...上 focus sth. on 把...集中在...上

examples.en: Rather than blame individuals, the inquiry will focus on weaknesses in the system.
examples.zh: 调查将聚焦制度缺陷，而不是指责任何个人。

examples.en: The retired judge is fond of telling humorous stories about his early career.
examples.zh: 这位退休法官喜欢讲述自己职业生涯早期的趣事。

examples.en: Strict water restrictions remain in force across the drought-hit province.
examples.zh: 严格的用水限制在受旱省份仍然有效。

examples.en: The regional trade agreement is scheduled to go into force next January.
examples.zh: 该地区贸易协定定于明年一月生效。

examples.en: The occupying troops removed villagers from their homes by force.
examples.zh: 占领军用武力把村民赶出了家园。

examples.en: Parents should not force their unfulfilled ambitions on their children.
examples.zh: 父母不应把自己未实现的抱负强加给孩子。

examples.en: The winners received assistance in the form of equipment rather than cash.
examples.zh: 获胜者得到的是设备形式的援助，而非现金。

examples.en: We were fortunate in finding a mechanic before the desert road grew dark.
examples.zh: 我们很幸运，在沙漠公路天黑前找到了一名修理工。

examples.en: Local buses will carry festival visitors free of charge this weekend.
examples.zh: 本周末，当地公交车将免费运送参加节庆活动的游客。

examples.en: Once freed from routine paperwork, teachers had more time for individual students.
examples.zh: 从日常文书工作中解脱出来后，教师有更多时间辅导每个学生。

meaning: 在...前面 in the front of 在...前部

examples.en: A cyclist stopped abruptly in front of the school gate.
examples.zh: 一名骑车人在校门前突然停了下来。

examples.en: Satellite images furnished the rescue team with precise coordinates.
examples.zh: 卫星图像为救援队提供了精确坐标。

examples.en: In general, native plants require less water than imported varieties.
examples.zh: 一般来说，本地植物比外来品种需要的水更少。

meaning: 瞥见(强调结果) take a glance(or look) at 看一眼(强调动作)

examples.en: From the train, Elena caught a glimpse of deer moving through the snow.
examples.zh: 埃琳娜从火车上瞥见几只鹿在雪地里穿行。

meaning: 对...有好处;对...有作用 be good at 擅长于; be good to 对...好

examples.en: A short walk after lunch can be good for both digestion and concentration.
examples.zh: 午饭后短暂散步对消化和注意力都有好处。

examples.en: The medical supplies arrived in good time for the vaccination campaign.
examples.zh: 医疗物资及时运到，赶上了疫苗接种活动。

examples.en: Following the factory closure, many skilled families left the town for good.
examples.zh: 工厂关闭后，许多技术工人家庭永远离开了小镇。

examples.en: Visitors often take the island's peace for granted, unaware of its turbulent history.
examples.zh: 游客常把岛上的和平视为理所当然，却不了解其动荡的历史。

phrase: be grateful to sb. for sth

examples.en: The stranded passengers were grateful to the villagers for sharing food and blankets.
examples.zh: 受困乘客感谢村民们分享食物和毯子。

examples.en: The visa request was rejected on the grounds of incomplete documentation.
examples.zh: 这份签证申请因材料不全而被拒绝。

examples.en: The proposal to merge the two libraries fell to the ground after public protests.
examples.zh: 合并两座图书馆的提议在公众抗议后落空了。

meaning: 谨防, 警惕 (be) on guard 站岗

examples.en: Young investors should be on their guard against promises of effortless wealth.
examples.zh: 年轻投资者应警惕不劳而获的承诺。

meaning: 警惕,防止 guard...against 警卫...防止

examples.en: Regular backups guard against the permanent loss of research data.
examples.zh: 定期备份可以防止研究数据永久丢失。

examples.en: Without accurate records, economists can only guess at the scale of informal employment.
examples.zh: 没有准确记录，经济学家只能推测非正规就业的规模。

examples.en: The child solved the first riddle by guess rather than reasoning.
examples.zh: 孩子不是靠推理，而是凭猜测解开了第一道谜题。

examples.en: The manufacturer was guilty of concealing evidence about the faulty brakes.
examples.zh: 这家制造商犯有隐瞒制动器故障证据的过错。

examples.en: Our night guard is in the habit of checking every window twice.
examples.zh: 我们的夜班警卫习惯把每扇窗户检查两遍。

examples.en: Replacing sweets with fruit helped Amir break off his habit of late-night snacking.
examples.zh: 用水果代替糖果帮助阿米尔戒掉了深夜吃零食的习惯。

examples.en: A patient tutor broke Mei of the habit of translating every sentence word for word.
examples.zh: 一位耐心的导师使小梅改掉了逐字翻译每句话的习惯。

phrase: get fall into the habit of

examples.en: Do not fall into the habit of postponing difficult conversations.
examples.zh: 不要养成把困难谈话一拖再拖的习惯。

examples.en: Traffic came to a halt when a herd of sheep wandered onto the highway.
examples.zh: 一群羊走上公路后，交通停了下来。

examples.en: With the harvest at hand, every available barn was being cleaned.
examples.zh: 收获在即，所有能用的谷仓都在打扫。

examples.en: Each ceramic tile in the entrance hall was painted by hand.
examples.zh: 门厅里的每块瓷砖都是手工绘制的。

meaning: 狼狈为奸, 密切合作

examples.en: The customs officer was found to be working hand in glove with smugglers.
examples.zh: 这名海关官员被发现与走私者相互勾结。

examples.en: With enough food in hand, the expedition could cross the plateau safely.
examples.zh: 有了充足的食物，这支探险队便能安全穿越高原。

meaning: 由...掌握, 控制, 负责

examples.en: The future of the wetland now lies in the hands of local planners.
examples.zh: 这片湿地的未来如今掌握在当地规划者手中。

examples.en: Seasonal workers often live from hand to mouth when tourism declines.
examples.zh: 旅游业不景气时，季节工往往只能勉强糊口。

examples.en: Dr. Okafor spent a decade at the head of the tropical disease institute.
examples.zh: 奥卡福博士担任这家热带疾病研究所负责人长达十年。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered as the fishing boats headed for the harbour.
examples.zh: 乌云聚集时，渔船纷纷驶向港口。

examples.en: Few residents had heard of the abandoned tunnel beneath the square.
examples.zh: 很少有居民听说过广场下面那条废弃隧道。

examples.en: Despite his stern manner, the headmaster is a generous man at heart.
examples.zh: 校长虽然态度严厉，内心却是个慷慨的人。

examples.en: In her heart of hearts, Rosa knew that the partnership could not last.
examples.zh: 罗莎内心深处明白，这段合作关系无法长久。

examples.en: Every guide must learn the mountain's emergency procedures by heart.
examples.zh: 每名向导都必须熟记山区应急程序。

examples.en: The young cellist thanked her audience with all her heart.
examples.zh: 年轻的大提琴手全心全意地感谢观众。

examples.en: Dense fog hindered the helicopter from landing near the injured climbers.
examples.zh: 浓雾阻碍直升机在受伤登山者附近降落。

meaning: 在(去)度假 go on holiday = go for a holiday

examples.en: The laboratory will close next week while its staff go on holiday.
examples.zh: 实验室下周将关闭，届时工作人员会去度假。

examples.en: Within days, the exchange student began to feel at home with her host family.
examples.zh: 几天之内，这名交换生便开始在寄宿家庭感到自在。

examples.en: The accountant was honest in explaining how the costly error had occurred.
examples.zh: 会计坦诚地解释了这个代价高昂的错误是如何发生的。

phrase: in one's honour (or in honour of)

examples.en: The observatory named a newly discovered asteroid in honour of its former director.
examples.zh: 天文台以其前任台长的名字命名了一颗新发现的小行星，以示纪念。

examples.en: On her honour, the athlete swore that she had never used a banned substance.
examples.zh: 这名运动员以名誉担保，发誓自己从未使用禁药。

examples.en: After years of conflict, border communities finally hope for lasting peace.
examples.zh: 经历多年冲突后，边境社区终于盼望持久和平。

examples.en: To our horror, smoke was pouring from the locked storage room.
examples.zh: 令我们惊恐的是，浓烟正从上锁的储藏室涌出。

examples.en: A diagnosis made in a hurry can overlook subtle but vital symptoms.
examples.zh: 仓促作出的诊断可能忽略细微却关键的症状。

examples.en: The handwriting on the receipt was identical with that in the suspect's notebook.
examples.zh: 收据上的字迹与嫌疑人笔记本中的字迹完全相同。

examples.en: For decades, the district has been identified with shipbuilding and heavy industry.
examples.zh: 几十年来，这一地区一直与造船业和重工业联系在一起。

examples.en: The hikers entered the valley in ignorance of the approaching storm.
examples.zh: 徒步者在不知道暴风雨将至的情况下进入了山谷。

examples.en: Many consumers are ignorant of how much personal data the application collects.
examples.zh: 许多消费者并不知道这款应用收集了多少个人数据。

examples.en: Rising sea temperatures have a profound impact on coral reproduction.
examples.zh: 海水温度上升对珊瑚繁殖有深远影响。

examples.en: The prolonged closure imposed severe hardship on nearby shop owners.
examples.zh: 长期停业给附近店主造成了严重困难。

examples.en: During training, pilots are impressed on with the need for calm communication.
examples.zh: 训练期间，教官反复向飞行员强调冷静沟通的必要性。

phrase: make leave an impression on sb. =give sb. an impression

examples.en: The candidate's thoughtful questions left a strong impression on the interview panel.
examples.zh: 这名候选人深思熟虑的问题给面试小组留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: I booked the room under the impression that breakfast was included.
examples.zh: 我以为房费包含早餐，所以预订了这个房间。

meaning: 把原物改进 improve on(=produce or be sth. better than...) 另做一物比原物更好

examples.en: Planting reeds along the banks has greatly improved the river's water quality.
examples.zh: 沿河岸种植芦苇大大改善了河流水质。

examples.en: With daily practice, Jonas improved in both pronunciation and confidence.
examples.zh: 通过每天练习，乔纳斯的发音和自信心都有所提高。

examples.en: Doctors observed a steady improvement in the patient's ability to walk.
examples.zh: 医生观察到患者的行走能力在稳步改善。

examples.en: Please include the original receipts in your travel expense claim.
examples.zh: 请把原始收据附在差旅费报销申请中。

examples.en: The tour costs 800 yuan, inclusive of accommodation and museum entry.
examples.zh: 这次旅行费用为八百元，包含住宿和博物馆门票。

examples.en: The ethics review must remain independent of the company funding the research.
examples.zh: 伦理审查必须独立于资助这项研究的公司。

examples.en: Persistent headaches may be indicative of a more serious condition.
examples.zh: 持续头痛可能表明存在更严重的疾病。

meaning: 对...漠不关心, 冷淡, 不在乎

examples.en: No good teacher can be indifferent to a child who is being excluded.
examples.zh: 任何好老师都不会对遭受排斥的孩子漠不关心。

meaning: 比...差; superior to 比...好

examples.en: Tests revealed that the cheaper filter was not inferior to the imported model.
examples.zh: 测试表明，这款较便宜的过滤器并不逊于进口型号。

examples.en: The airline informed passengers of the cancellation by text message.
examples.zh: 航空公司通过短信告知乘客航班取消。

examples.en: DNA evidence proved that the imprisoned man was innocent of the robbery.
examples.zh: DNA证据证明，这名入狱男子没有犯抢劫罪。

examples.en: My editor insisted on checking every quotation against the original recording.
examples.zh: 我的编辑坚持把每条引语与原始录音核对。

examples.en: Instead of widening the road, planners introduced a frequent bus service.
examples.zh: 规划者没有拓宽道路，而是开通了班次频繁的公交服务。

examples.en: Veteran farmers instructed the volunteers in methods of conserving soil moisture.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的农民向志愿者传授保持土壤水分的方法。

meaning: 把...保险(多少钱); ensure 使安全; assure...(of) 使...确信,保证

examples.en: The gallery insured the borrowed portrait for two million dollars.
examples.zh: 画廊为借来的肖像画投保了两百万美元。

examples.en: Small farmers can insure their crops against damage caused by hail.
examples.zh: 小农户可以为作物投保冰雹损失险。

examples.en: These simplified instructions are intended for users with limited technical experience.
examples.zh: 这些简化说明是为技术经验有限的用户编写的。

examples.en: Intent on finding the source of the leak, Ava ignored the lunchtime bell.
examples.zh: 艾娃一心寻找泄漏源，连午餐铃声都没理会。

meaning: 符合...的利益 be interested in 对...感兴趣

examples.en: In the interests of fairness, every applicant will answer the same questions.
examples.zh: 为公平起见，每位申请人都将回答相同的问题。

meaning: 干涉, interfere with 打搅,干扰

examples.en: Outside powers should not interfere in the country's peaceful election.
examples.zh: 外部势力不应干涉该国的和平选举。

meaning: 每隔一会儿, 每隔一段距离

examples.en: Emergency announcements sounded at intervals throughout the night.
examples.zh: 整个夜晚，每隔一段时间就会响起紧急通知。

examples.en: A trained mediator intervened in the dispute before it became violent.
examples.zh: 在争端演变为暴力冲突前，一名受过训练的调解员进行了干预。

examples.en: The family business invested in energy-efficient ovens to reduce fuel costs.
examples.zh: 这家族企业投资购买节能烤箱，以降低燃料成本。

examples.en: More than forty laboratories are involved in the international vaccine study.
examples.zh: 四十多家实验室参与了这项国际疫苗研究。

examples.en: The warning light switched off by itself after the engine cooled.
examples.zh: 发动机冷却后，警示灯自行熄灭了。

meaning: 本身; of itself 自发,自然

examples.en: Competition is not harmful in itself; the rules surrounding it matter.
examples.zh: 竞争本身并无害处，关键在于相应的规则。

examples.en: Luis was jealous of his sister's freedom to travel abroad.
examples.zh: 路易斯嫉妒妹妹能够自由出国旅行。

examples.en: When offered a place on the Arctic expedition, Salma jumped at the opportunity.
examples.zh: 萨尔玛一获得参加北极考察的机会，便欣然接受了。

examples.en: Online critics jumped on the minister's careless choice of words.
examples.zh: 网络批评者抓住部长用词不慎这一点猛烈抨击。

meaning: 年纪较...轻, 职位较...低.

examples.en: Though junior to everyone else in the studio, Ken led its most demanding project.
examples.zh: 肯虽然比工作室其他所有人资历浅，却领导了最艰巨的项目。

examples.en: Teenagers in the coastal town are keen on learning traditional boatbuilding.
examples.zh: 这个海滨小镇的青少年热衷于学习传统造船技艺。

examples.en: Rangers keep a close watch on the nesting turtles during tourist season.
examples.zh: 旅游季期间，护林员密切观察筑巢的海龟。

examples.en: Daniel kept the discovery to himself until he could verify the measurements.
examples.zh: 丹尼尔在核实测量结果前一直没有把发现告诉别人。

examples.en: To the best of my knowledge, this is the only surviving copy of the map.
examples.zh: 据我所知，这是这幅地图唯一留存下来的副本。

meaning: 在逃, 逍遥法外 at large(=in general) 一般来说, 大体上 at large(=at full length; with details)详细地

examples.en: The escaped leopard remained at large despite an extensive search.
examples.zh: 尽管进行了大规模搜寻，那只逃脱的豹子仍未被捕获。

examples.en: Tired from the climb, Nikhil leaned against a pine tree to catch his breath.
examples.zh: 尼基尔爬山累了，便靠在一棵松树上喘口气。

meaning: 至少; at most 至多

examples.en: The repair will take at least three days if replacement parts arrive promptly.
examples.zh: 如果替换零件及时送到，维修至少需要三天。

meaning: 一点(也不), 丝毫(也不)

examples.en: The surgeon seemed not in the least alarmed by the unexpected complication.
examples.zh: 这位外科医生似乎对意外并发症一点也不惊慌。

examples.en: Guests can explore the botanical gardens at their leisure after breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐后，客人可以从容游览植物园。

examples.en: This quiet attic lends itself perfectly to concentrated study.
examples.zh: 这间安静的阁楼非常适合专心学习。

meaning: 终于 at length (=in detail, thoroughly)详细地

examples.en: After wandering through minor details, the speaker discussed the central issue at length.
examples.zh: 发言人绕了许多枝节后，终于详细讨论了核心问题。

meaning: 想一切办法, 尽一切力量

examples.en: Some collectors will go to any length to obtain a rare first edition.
examples.zh: 有些收藏家会不惜一切代价获得珍贵的初版本。

examples.en: Untreated pipes are liable to burst during a severe frost.
examples.zh: 未经处理的水管在严寒中容易爆裂。

examples.en: Under the lease, tenants are liable for damage beyond ordinary wear.
examples.zh: 根据租约，租户须对超出正常磨损的损坏负责。

examples.en: The village's appeal lies in its unspoiled landscape and slow pace of life.
examples.zh: 这个村庄的魅力在于其原始自然的风景和缓慢的生活节奏。

examples.en: Her greatest aim in life was to make science accessible to ordinary people.
examples.zh: 她一生最大的目标是让普通人也能理解科学。

examples.en: After the ceremony, each volunteer became a member of the rescue association for life.
examples.zh: 仪式结束后，每名志愿者都成为救援协会的终身会员。

examples.en: In the light of new evidence, prosecutors reopened the thirty-year-old case.
examples.zh: 鉴于新证据，检察官重新调查了这桩三十年前的案件。

meaning: 使...更为清楚, 提供线索, 阐明

examples.en: Recently discovered letters throw light on the poet's years in exile.
examples.zh: 新近发现的信件揭示了这位诗人流亡岁月的情况。

examples.en: Pay increases will be adjusted in line with the annual rate of inflation.
examples.zh: 工资增幅将根据年度通货膨胀率进行调整。

examples.en: During the endless polar night, the crew longed for sunlight and fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 在漫长的极夜期间，船员们渴望阳光和新鲜水果。

meaning: 很久,很长时间(否定句.疑问句中)

examples.en: The secret tunnel did not remain undiscovered for long.
examples.zh: 这条秘密隧道没有隐藏多久就被发现了。

meaning: 不久, 过了不久以后.

examples.en: Before long, tiny shoots appeared where the wildfire had blackened the hillside.
examples.zh: 没过多久，被山火烧黑的山坡上便冒出了嫩芽。

meaning: 从长远来说,最后; in the short term (从短期来说)

examples.en: Restoring the soil may be expensive now, but it will benefit every farmer in the long run.
examples.zh: 修复土壤眼下可能代价高昂，但从长远来看会惠及每一位农民。

examples.en: Faced with three conflicting maps, even the guide was at a loss.
examples.zh: 面对三张相互矛盾的地图，就连向导也不知所措。

examples.en: Mina hopes to major in environmental engineering at university.
examples.zh: 米娜希望在大学主修环境工程。

examples.en: As a matter of fact, the supposedly ancient vase was made last year.
examples.zh: 事实上，那只据称很古老的花瓶是去年制作的。

meaning: 不惜一切. (=certainly) 当然行;by means of 用...; by no means 完全不, 决不

examples.en: By all means, borrow my notes if they help you revise.
examples.zh: 当然可以，如果我的笔记有助于你复习，就拿去用吧。

examples.en: Residents planted an oak in memory of the firefighter.
examples.zh: 居民们种下一棵橡树来纪念那位消防员。

examples.en: After a week of rest, my injured ankle is finally on the mend.
examples.zh: 休息一周后，我受伤的脚踝终于在好转。

examples.en: Please mention the delivery delay to Ms. Chen before lunch.
examples.zh: 请在午饭前向陈女士提一下送货延误的事。

examples.en: Without reliable irrigation, the crops remain at the mercy of the weather.
examples.zh: 没有可靠的灌溉，庄稼仍只能任由天气摆布。

meaning: 乱七八糟, 处境困难 make a mess of 弄乱, 打乱

examples.en: After the rushed move, every room was in a mess.
examples.zh: 匆忙搬家后，每个房间都乱七八糟。

examples.en: Bear in mind that the last ferry leaves at nine.
examples.zh: 请牢记，末班渡轮九点出发。

examples.en: That familiar melody brought my first school concert to mind.
examples.zh: 那段熟悉的旋律使我想起第一次学校音乐会。

meaning: 由于粗心,健忘原因而)错误地

examples.en: I took your umbrella by mistake because ours look identical.
examples.zh: 我误拿了你的伞，因为我们的伞看起来一模一样。

meaning: 此刻,现在 for the moment (=for the time being)暂时 just a moment 稍等片刻 at the last moment 在最后一刻

examples.en: At the moment, the laboratory is closed for maintenance.
examples.zh: 目前，实验室因维修而关闭。

examples.en: After the long hike, nobody was in the mood for an argument.
examples.zh: 长途徒步后，谁也没有心情争论。

examples.en: A flashy title is no more a guarantee of quality than a high price is.
examples.zh: 花哨的标题并不能保证质量，正如高价也不能一样。

examples.en: For the most part, commuters welcomed the new bus route.
examples.zh: 总的来说，通勤者欢迎这条新公交线路。

examples.en: The repair should take two hours at the most.
examples.zh: 这次维修最多需要两小时。

examples.en: With only one afternoon in Suzhou, we made the most of every minute.
examples.zh: 在苏州只有一个下午，我们充分利用了每一分钟。

meaning: 不是很好的... be something of 有点...,像...

examples.en: This dim café is not much of a place for reading.
examples.zh: 这家昏暗的咖啡馆不太适合阅读。

examples.en: The astronomer named the newly found comet after her mentor.
examples.zh: 这位天文学家用导师的名字为新发现的彗星命名。

examples.en: These wild orchids are native to the mountain valleys of Yunnan.
examples.zh: 这些野生兰花原产于云南的山谷。

examples.en: Leo is quiet by nature but speaks confidently on stage.
examples.zh: 利奥天生安静，但在舞台上讲话很自信。

examples.en: The two proposals differ in form but are similar in nature.
examples.zh: 这两项提议形式不同，但本质相似。

examples.en: Her brief visit was in the nature of an informal inspection.
examples.zh: 她的短暂来访带有非正式视察的性质。

examples.en: The anonymous donor was none other than our former librarian.
examples.zh: 那位匿名捐赠者不是别人，正是我们以前的图书管理员。

examples.en: His temperature remained slightly above normal throughout the night.
examples.zh: 他的体温整夜都略高于正常值。

examples.en: The gallery lets local students attend its workshops for nothing.
examples.zh: 这家画廊让当地学生免费参加工作坊。

examples.en: Under the dust lay nothing but an empty wooden box.
examples.zh: 灰尘下面不过是一个空木箱。

examples.en: The cabin lacks electricity, to say nothing of internet access.
examples.zh: 这间小屋连电都没有，更不用说网络了。

examples.en: Could you arrange extra chairs at such short notice?
examples.zh: 时间这么仓促，你能安排到额外的椅子吗？

examples.en: The footpath will remain closed until further notice.
examples.zh: 这条步道在另行通知前将一直关闭。

examples.en: Few shoppers took notice of the small warning beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 很少有顾客注意到入口旁的小警告。

examples.en: Several residents objected to turning the wetland into a car park.
examples.zh: 几位居民反对把湿地改成停车场。

examples.en: Her main objection to working remotely is the lack of human contact.
examples.zh: 她反对远程办公的主要理由是缺少人与人的接触。

examples.en: On occasion, the museum opens its archive to graduate students.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆偶尔会向研究生开放档案室。

examples.en: By occasion of the town's centenary, a public garden was opened.
examples.zh: 值此建镇百年之际，一座公共花园开放了。

examples.en: During the voyage, he occupied himself with cataloguing seabirds.
examples.zh: 航行期间，他忙于给海鸟分类编目。

examples.en: It occurred to Jia that the key might still be in the bicycle lock.
examples.zh: 佳突然想到，钥匙可能还插在自行车锁里。

phrase: once and for all =once and forever
meaning: 永远地 all at once (=suddenly, now) 立即,马上 once in a while (=occasionally) 偶尔 (just) for once 就这一次

examples.en: We must settle the boundary dispute once and for all.
examples.zh: 我们必须彻底解决这场边界争端。

examples.en: At sixteen, Nora travelled across the country all by herself.
examples.zh: 诺拉十六岁时独自一人走遍了全国。

meaning: 给某人做手术 operation n. come/ go into operation 开始运转 put/bring sth. into operation 使...投产,运转

examples.en: Surgeons operated on the injured eagle before releasing it months later.
examples.zh: 外科医生给受伤的鹰做了手术，几个月后将其放归自然。

examples.en: Most historians are of the opinion that the letter is authentic.
examples.zh: 大多数历史学家认为这封信是真迹。

examples.en: In my opinion, clear feedback matters more than frequent testing.
examples.zh: 在我看来，清晰的反馈比频繁测试更重要。

examples.en: Local fishermen are opposed to dumping waste near the reef.
examples.zh: 当地渔民反对在珊瑚礁附近倾倒废物。

examples.en: The library is opposite to the post office across the square.
examples.zh: 图书馆在广场对面，与邮局相对。

meaning: 合适的,恰当的 in order 井井有条,处于良好状态; out of order(=in bad condition)出毛病,发生故障

examples.en: Your passport is in order, so you may proceed to the gate.
examples.zh: 你的护照手续齐全，可以前往登机口。

examples.en: For the ceremony, he wore a jacket made to order in Hangzhou.
examples.zh: 参加典礼时，他穿了一件在杭州定做的夹克。

examples.en: The custom originated in fishing villages along the northern coast.
examples.zh: 这一习俗起源于北部沿海的渔村。

examples.en: A solar farm now stands on the outskirts of the desert town.
examples.zh: 如今，这座沙漠小镇的郊外建有一座太阳能电站。

examples.en: She owes her calm manner to years of emergency-room experience.
examples.zh: 她把自己的沉着归功于多年急诊室工作的经历。

examples.en: After some basic training, the volunteers can work on their own.
examples.zh: 经过基础培训后，志愿者可以独立工作。

examples.en: Every child deserves a desk of his or her own.
examples.zh: 每个孩子都应该有一张属于自己的书桌。

examples.en: Small farms struggle to keep pace with changing food-safety rules.
examples.zh: 小农场难以跟上不断变化的食品安全规定。

examples.en: The translator took great pains to preserve the poet's playful tone.
examples.zh: 译者下了很大功夫来保留诗人诙谐的语气。

examples.en: Grandfather refused to part with the watch he had carried for sixty years.
examples.zh: 祖父不肯舍弃那块戴了六十年的手表。

examples.en: More than forty schools participated in the robotics challenge.
examples.zh: 四十多所学校参加了机器人挑战赛。

examples.en: Our chef is particular about the freshness of every herb.
examples.zh: 我们的厨师对每一种香草的新鲜度都很讲究。

examples.en: One passage in particular captures the loneliness of city life.
examples.zh: 有一段尤其生动地刻画了城市生活的孤独。

examples.en: Her passion for astronomy began with a borrowed telescope.
examples.zh: 她对天文学的热爱始于一架借来的望远镜。

examples.en: Good instructors are patient with learners who repeat the same error.
examples.zh: 优秀的教师会耐心对待反复犯同一错误的学习者。

meaning: 赔偿, 付款, 报偿, 处罚

examples.en: The factory will pay for the damage caused by the chemical leak.
examples.zh: 工厂将赔偿化学品泄漏造成的损失。

examples.en: We paid the farmer fifty yuan for the basket of peaches.
examples.zh: 我们付给农民五十元买下这篮桃子。

meaning: 与...和睦相处 in peace (=peacefully)安静,平安

examples.en: Having apologized honestly, she is now at peace with her sister.
examples.zh: 真诚道歉后，她现在与姐姐和睦相处了。

examples.en: This clicking sound is peculiar to older models of the camera.
examples.zh: 这种咔嗒声是老款相机特有的。

examples.en: Late submission carries a penalty of five marks.
examples.zh: 迟交作业会被扣五分。

examples.en: At the charity evening, a young doctor performed Chopin on the piano.
examples.zh: 在慈善晚会上，一位年轻医生用钢琴演奏了肖邦的作品。

examples.en: Despite repeated failures, the team persisted in testing the vaccine.
examples.zh: 尽管屡次失败，团队仍坚持测试这种疫苗。

examples.en: Applicants must collect their certificates in person.
examples.zh: 申请人必须亲自领取证书。

phrase: in place (in right or proper place)

examples.en: Once the final tile was in place, the mosaic formed a blue whale.
examples.zh: 最后一块瓷砖就位后，马赛克拼图呈现出一头蓝鲸。

examples.en: A handwritten sign served in place of the broken traffic light.
examples.zh: 一块手写标牌代替了损坏的交通灯。

examples.en: My aunt takes great pleasure in teaching children to bake.
examples.zh: 我姑姑很喜欢教孩子们烘焙。

phrase: be on the point of doing sth

examples.en: I was on the point of leaving when the missing parcel arrived.
examples.zh: 我正要离开时，丢失的包裹送到了。

examples.en: Whether the speaker wore jeans is beside the point.
examples.zh: 演讲者是否穿牛仔裤无关紧要。

examples.en: After several jokes, the host finally came to the point.
examples.zh: 讲了几个笑话后，主持人终于谈到了正题。

phrase: there is no point in doing sth

examples.en: There is no point in blaming the intern for a system-wide failure.
examples.zh: 把整个系统的故障归咎于实习生毫无意义。

examples.en: Her answer was brief but entirely to the point.
examples.zh: 她的回答简短却完全切中要点。

meaning: 指着 point out (=indicate, show) 指出,指明

examples.en: The toddler pointed at the moon reflected in the pond.
examples.zh: 那个幼儿指着池塘里月亮的倒影。

examples.en: This affordable clinic is popular among elderly residents.
examples.zh: 这家收费适中的诊所很受老年居民欢迎。

examples.en: As a witness, you are in the position of being able to clarify the sequence.
examples.zh: 作为目击者，你能够澄清事情的先后顺序。

meaning: 实际上(状语);业务熟练(表语)

examples.en: The method sounds elegant, but does it work in practice?
examples.zh: 这个方法听起来很巧妙，但在实际中有效吗？

examples.en: Without weekly rehearsals, the choir soon got out of practice.
examples.zh: 没有每周排练，合唱团很快就生疏了。

examples.en: A pilot scheme helped bring the recycling idea into practice.
examples.zh: 一项试点计划帮助把回收利用的构想付诸实践。

examples.en: Many passengers prefer the slower train to an overnight bus.
examples.zh: 许多乘客宁愿坐较慢的火车，也不愿乘夜班公交。

meaning: 准备吃早饭 prepare breakfast 作早饭

examples.en: While I prepared for breakfast, Rui ground fresh coffee beans.
examples.zh: 我准备吃早饭时，瑞磨了新鲜的咖啡豆。

examples.en: The seal was opened in the presence of two independent observers.
examples.zh: 封条是在两名独立观察员在场的情况下开启的。

meaning: 暂且,就现在来说; at present 现在,此刻

examples.en: For the present, the rescued fox will remain at the wildlife centre.
examples.zh: 目前，这只获救的狐狸将留在野生动物中心。

examples.en: Professor Lin presided over a lively discussion on artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 林教授主持了一场关于人工智能的热烈讨论。

meaning: 占优势, 压倒, 战胜

examples.en: Patience eventually prevailed over the child's fear of deep water.
examples.zh: 耐心最终战胜了孩子对深水的恐惧。

examples.en: Thick curtains prevent street noise from disturbing the patients.
examples.zh: 厚窗帘能防止街道噪声打扰病人。

examples.en: Previous to the excavation, little was known about the settlement.
examples.zh: 在发掘之前，人们对这个聚落知之甚少。

examples.en: The village takes pride in its tradition of welcoming strangers.
examples.zh: 这个村庄以热情接待陌生人的传统为荣。

examples.en: He prides himself on remembering every customer's name.
examples.zh: 他以能记住每位顾客的名字而自豪。

examples.en: In principle, the hall is available to any student society.
examples.zh: 原则上，任何学生社团都可以使用这个大厅。

examples.en: All equipment must be inspected prior to the diving lesson.
examples.zh: 所有设备都必须在潜水课前接受检查。

meaning: 私下, 秘密地 in public 公开地

examples.en: The two diplomats discussed the proposal in private.
examples.zh: 两位外交官私下讨论了这项提议。

meaning: 由...发出, 由...引起(产生)

examples.en: The strange vibration proceeded from a loose panel beneath the floor.
examples.zh: 那阵奇怪的振动来自地板下面一块松动的面板。

examples.en: Once the fog lifted, the rescue crew proceeded with the search.
examples.zh: 雾散后，救援人员继续搜寻。

examples.en: Restoration of the old theatre is still in progress.
examples.zh: 老剧院的修复工作仍在进行中。

examples.en: New regulations prohibit shops from selling tobacco to minors.
examples.zh: 新规禁止商店向未成年人出售烟草。

examples.en: Trees were planted in proportion to the size of each district.
examples.zh: 各区按其面积大小成比例地种植树木。

examples.en: A layer of wax protects the wooden bowl from moisture.
examples.zh: 一层蜡保护木碗不受潮。

examples.en: The apprentice was proud of repairing the clock without help.
examples.zh: 学徒为自己独立修好时钟感到自豪。

examples.en: Emergency funds provide for families displaced by the flood.
examples.zh: 应急资金为因洪水流离失所的家庭提供保障。

examples.en: For the first time, the scientist spoke in public about her failure.
examples.zh: 这位科学家第一次公开谈论自己的失败。

examples.en: Someone had loosened the gate on purpose.
examples.zh: 有人故意把大门弄松了。

examples.en: His final observation was concise and to the purpose.
examples.zh: 他最后的看法简洁而中肯。

meaning: 在某种科目或学科上合格 be qualified for 在某种职业上合格

examples.en: Although qualified in chemistry, Sara now writes historical novels.
examples.zh: 萨拉虽然具备化学专业资质，如今却在写历史小说。

examples.en: Contradictory dates call the explorer's account into question.
examples.zh: 相互矛盾的日期使人们对探险家的叙述产生怀疑。

examples.en: Beyond all question, clean water is essential to public health.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，清洁用水对公共健康至关重要。

examples.en: Buying a house near campus is out of the question on my salary.
examples.zh: 以我的工资，在校园附近买房是不可能的。

examples.en: The painting in question has not been displayed since 1998.
examples.zh: 所谈及的那幅画自1998年以来一直没有展出。

examples.en: Without question, her calm leadership prevented further panic.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，她沉着的领导避免了进一步的恐慌。

examples.en: Cycling home without a coat, I was caught in the rain.
examples.zh: 我没穿外套骑车回家，结果淋了雨。

meaning: 随便地, 任意地, 胡乱地

examples.en: To test memory fairly, the numbers appeared on screen at random.
examples.zh: 为了公平测试记忆力，数字在屏幕上随机出现。

examples.en: Her research ranges over economics, history, and urban design.
examples.zh: 她的研究范围涵盖经济学、历史和城市设计。

examples.en: Ticket prices range between twenty and eighty yuan.
examples.zh: 票价在二十元到八十元之间不等。

examples.en: At any rate, we reached shelter before the storm intensified.
examples.zh: 无论如何，我们在暴风雨加剧前到达了避难所。

examples.en: Such specialist equipment is beyond the reach of most village clinics.
examples.zh: 这种专业设备是大多数乡村诊所无法获得的。

meaning: 无法够到. within reach of (or within one's reach) 够得到,能拿到

examples.en: Keep the medicine out of reach of young children.
examples.zh: 请把药放在幼童够不到的地方。

examples.en: Markets reacted positively to the unexpected fall in energy prices.
examples.zh: 市场对能源价格意外下跌作出了积极反应。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can react upon a driver's judgment.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足会影响驾驶员的判断力。

examples.en: Young readers often react against books chosen entirely by adults.
examples.zh: 年轻读者常会抵触完全由成年人挑选的书。

examples.en: By dawn, the medical team was ready for the first patients.
examples.zh: 到黎明时，医疗队已准备好接诊第一批病人。

examples.en: The apparently simple puzzle is, in reality, extremely demanding.
examples.zh: 这个看似简单的谜题实际上极其费脑。

examples.en: Punishing everyone for one person's error is beyond all reason.
examples.zh: 因一个人的错误而惩罚所有人毫无道理。

examples.en: Flights were cancelled by reason of volcanic ash in the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 由于大气中的火山灰，航班被取消了。

examples.en: It stands to reason that better lighting will reduce reading fatigue.
examples.zh: 改善照明会减轻阅读疲劳，这是理所当然的。

examples.en: I tried to reason with the landlord about the sudden rent increase.
examples.zh: 我试图劝房东重新考虑突然涨租的问题。

meaning: 亏损,负债,赤字 (be) get out of red 不再亏损

examples.en: After three poor seasons, the family business slipped into the red.
examples.zh: 连续三个淡季后，这家家族企业陷入亏损。

examples.en: Locals refer to the narrow passage as Whispering Lane.
examples.zh: 当地人把这条狭窄的通道称为“低语巷”。

examples.en: The receptionist referred my complaint to the duty manager.
examples.zh: 接待员把我的投诉转交给了值班经理。

examples.en: With reference to your application, an interview has been arranged for Friday.
examples.zh: 关于你的申请，面试已安排在星期五。

examples.en: Several questions arose with regard to the accuracy of the survey.
examples.zh: 关于调查的准确性，出现了几个问题。

examples.en: Please give my regards to your parents when you call them.
examples.zh: 你给父母打电话时，请代我向他们问好。

examples.en: The marathon continued regardless of the heavy coastal wind.
examples.zh: 尽管沿海风势很大，马拉松比赛仍继续进行。

examples.en: The chart is misleading in relation to population growth.
examples.zh: 这张图表在涉及人口增长方面具有误导性。

examples.en: Attach only documents relevant to your insurance claim.
examples.zh: 只附上与你的保险索赔有关的文件。

examples.en: To our relief, the missing hikers emerged from the forest unharmed.
examples.zh: 令我们放心的是，失踪的徒步者安然无恙地走出了森林。

examples.en: A porter relieved the elderly traveller of her heavy suitcase.
examples.zh: 一名搬运工帮那位年长旅客拿走了沉重的行李箱。

examples.en: Remote villages rely on radio for severe-weather warnings.
examples.zh: 偏远村庄依靠无线电接收恶劣天气预警。

examples.en: Reviewers remarked on the actor's remarkable control of silence.
examples.zh: 评论家谈到了那位演员对沉默的出色把控。

meaning: 对...治疗法, 补救, 药物

examples.en: Regular exercise can be an effective remedy for mild stress.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼可以有效缓解轻度压力。

meaning: 提醒某人...,使某人向想起

examples.en: The scent of pine reminded Mei of childhood winters.
examples.zh: 松树的气味使梅想起童年的冬天。
